queue.what: TFI International's final-mile unit, which delivers e-commerce, B2B and big-and-bulky parcels same-day and next-day through a network of U.S. and Canadian facilities and contracted delivery partners.
Regional last-mile carrier that e-commerce brands use for next-day residential delivery; one source groups it with OnTrac and LSO, and I did not confirm the size of its U.S. footprint.
